plan.title: Select Existing Evaluation Event with Bid

steps.note: Open the Events list where the buyer can choose among Live, History, Drafts, and Recurring events.
Verify the list rendered with the Create Event control and no error.
Restrict selection to currently live events, which can contain an event in evaluation.
Open the first Live event whose card shows the required In - Evaluation state.
Capture the selected event page so its visible title and RFX identifier are available as evidence.
Confirm the opened event still displays the required evaluation status.
Verify that the buyer's Responses view shows at least one submitted bid.
